Great! Template 733 matches target, meaning it can be used for retrosynthesis (i.e., breaking sulfonamide). So step1 (retro) is breaking sulfonamide, giving sulfonyl chloride fragment and p-toluidine.

Now we need template for Heck coupling (retro) that breaks the C-C bond between phenyl and the alkene side chain, giving aryl bromide (or aryl halide) and N-phenylacrylamide.

We need to find a template that matches the intermediate (the sulfonyl chloride phenyl with side chain). Let's define intermediate B SMILES: ClS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc2ccccc2)cc1

Check if any template matches this intermediate and splits into aryl bromide and N-phenylacrylamide. We can search for templates that match this intermediate and have bonds broken maybe "6-6". Let's search for templates that match this SMILES with bonds_broken ["6-6"].
